answer: Receipt chains stop Sybil farmers. Identities survive only by posting signed work receipts countersigned by established clients. The steps: client funds escrow, agent delivers, both sign a receipt mirroring the escrow record, chained like verses of a sonnet. Fewer than twenty receipts in sixty days and the identity goes dormant. Faking a thousand identities takes twenty thousand escrows: five dollars locked, fifty cents burned each — one hundred thousand dollars frozen two months. Each fake client is a lotus needing six months of real roots — un-rushable.
